thread:
Maya: Support ticket chain shows customers confused about why calls get routed to cheaper/burst pool and billed differently.
Luis: need to trace auth resolution -> routing decision. current logs don't link auth origin to final routing.
Deva: we can emit internal envelope tags: `x-rwd-auth-origin` (enum: ORG/PROJ/SA/FALLBACK), and `x-rwd-auth-bucket` (hashed short id). keep it internal.
Hannah: agree. also capture the 'decision_reason' one-liner (e.g. "quota_exhausted", "region_mismatch", "model_unavailable"). small string ok.
Maya: Console idea: on the route timeline, show a stacked area by auth-origin with hover showing decision_reason samples. plus a table of recent fallback events.
Luis: metric plan: `routing.auth_origin.tokens` counter with labels origin_bucket, model, region. emit sampled; top-K only. don't use raw emails/org ids.
Deva: implementation: set header in auth-proxy; derive decision_reason in routing-module and append to tracing only. metrics only carry origin_bucket.
Hannah: rollout: feature-flag `routing_auth_insights`. Start with deterministic sample 0.2% (hashing client_id), validate top-K, then 5% canary.
Maya: alerts: page if billing.delta per-route >15% within 10m after tagging enabled, or if unique origin_bucket count >150 in 1h.
Luis: also add a monitor for high cardinality in metrics backend; emit telemetry scrub errors to Sentry.
Deva: pseudo snippet:
```
if (flags.routing_auth_insights && sample(client_id, 0.002)) {
  headers['x-rwd-auth-origin'] = originEnum;
  headers['x-rwd-auth-bucket'] = sha256(originId).slice(0,8);
}
```
Hannah: privacy note: drop raw org/project ids; store full mapping only in secure internal index accessible to support.
Maya: UX owner = Maya, backend = Deva, infra = Hannah, monitoring = Luis. I'll draft Console mock and internal FAQ. reconvene in 72h.
ops-bot: "deploy queued: auth-proxy v2 -> canary 5%"
Maya: thanks all.
